theorems.name: Submission.arp_ball_subset_of_closed_rel_open
theorems.statement: ∀ {m : ℕ} (D : Set (Rn m)) (c : Rn m) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → IsClosed D → c ∈ D → (∀ w ∈ D ∩ ball c R, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ball w ε ∩ ball c R ⊆ D) → ball c R ⊆ D
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
